tagline: Regional bank holding company providing comprehensive financial services
hero_kpi_rationale: Strategic sale of $3.16 billion in securities in 2025, generating a net after-tax loss of $625.6 million, reflecting a major balance sheet restructuring to reduce negative arbitrage between long-term bond yields and short-term funding costs

kpis.name: Research and Development Investments
kpis.description: R&D investments are not materially disclosed in the 10-K report of a financial services institution

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on investments and fixed assets
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are not clearly isolated in the 10-K report

kpis.name: Net Realized Loss on Sale of Securities
kpis.explanation: Net after-tax realized loss on sale of securities
kpis.description: Sale of $3.16 billion in amortized cost of available-for-sale securities and reclassification of $3.59 billion in held-to-maturity securities, generating a net after-tax loss of $625.6 million at an effective tax rate of 21.946%, aimed at reducing negative arbitrage and funding costs
kpis.signal: Significant loss - strategic balance sheet restructuring

kpis.name: Annual Net Loss
kpis.description: Net loss of $397.6 million in 2025 compared to net income of $152.7 million in 2024, including charges related to the securities sale loss ($630.7 million after tax), branch network resizing initiatives, loss on sale of an equipment finance business, and early retirement costs
kpis.signal: Significant loss - impact of exceptional charges

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.description: Total deposits amounted to $20.18 billion as of December 31, 2025, compared to $21.89 billion as of December 31, 2024, reflecting repayments of high-rate uninsured and public deposits as part of balance sheet restructuring

kpis.name: Uninsured Deposits
kpis.explanation: Uninsured deposits as a percentage of total deposits
kpis.description: Uninsured deposits (excluding collateralized and intercompany deposits) amounted to approximately $4.55 billion, or 23% of total deposits, as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Equity Capital Raised
kpis.explanation: Equity capital raised during the period
kpis.description: Successfully raised $326.9 million in equity capital to reposition the balance sheet and support future growth

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Information Security Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions the board of directors' and management's awareness of cyber risks, as well as employee training. The board regularly receives reports from the CISO and CIO. Significant security incidents are escalated to management. The intensity of language and frequency of mentions suggest a significant concern.

risks.title: Risks Related to Critical Accounting Estimates
risks.score_rationale: The document details several critical estimates (loan losses, acquisitions, goodwill, taxes) requiring subjective assumptions and subject to variability. The language intensity underscores the inherent uncertainty in discounted cash flow calculations and market assumptions. These estimates are crucial to financial health.

risks.title: Risks Related to Securities Portfolio Management
risks.score_rationale: The significant sale of $3.16 billion in securities in 2025 resulted in a realized after-tax loss of $625.6 million, highlighting the volatility and market risk associated with investments. The reclassification of $3.59 billion in held-to-maturity securities reflects substantial exposure to interest rate risk. Portfolio management is a key element for a financial institution.

risks.title: Risks Related to Acquisitions and Integration
risks.score_rationale: The company uses the acquisition method of accounting (ASC 805), which involves valuing acquired assets at fair value and adjusting for premiums/discounts based on discounted cash flows. While not explicitly detailed as a major risk, this process is complex and may lead to valuation uncertainties. This risk is relevant for external growth.

risks.title: Risks Related to Litigation and Contingent Liabilities
risks.score_rationale: The document refers to Note 21 regarding contingent liabilities and mentions exposure to litigation in various contexts (lending activities, deposit activities, employment practices, commercial agreements, fiduciary responsibilities, compliance and anti-money laundering programs). Although details are referenced elsewhere, the mention indicates potential exposure to substantial costs. This risk is standard for financial institutions.

risks.title: Risks Related to General Economic Conditions and Regulatory Environment
risks.score_rationale: The document states that share repurchase decisions are influenced by general economic conditions. Moreover, critical accounting estimates depend on market and economic conditions. Regulatory authorities (FRB, CFPB, etc.) may impose material sanctions and restrictions on growth and M&A activities. This risk is fundamental to the banking sector.

ai_positioning.summary: SFNC does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F filing.
